data.one_liner: Completion functionality for Dart Command-Line Interfaces built using CommandRunner.
data.what_it_does: Provides tab completion functionality for Dart Command-Line Interfaces built using CommandRunner. Automatically installs or allows manual installation of shell completion files.
use_when: You are building a custom Dart command-line interface using CommandRunner.
You want to provide tab-completion functionality for your CLI users.
avoid_when: You are not using CommandRunner for your Dart CLI.
strengths: Automates completion file installation on first run.
Supports multiple shells like bash and zsh.
weaknesses: Requires manual zsh setup if not using a framework like Oh My Zsh.
Requires fast tracking the completion command if extra checks are run.
data.setup_notes: Add cli_completion to your dependencies and extend CompletionCommandRunner in your CommandRunner class.
